scope: Fresh anonymous FAQ expansion and own analytics preference only. No actual portfolio reset, data clearing, account/order/contact submission performed.
question: How do I reset my virtual portfolio?
answer: Guest records are browser-held; clearing site data removes the local copy. Signed-in cash and open positions can also have a synced account copy when the service is available. Clearing browser data does not delete or reset that account copy. Trade history, journals and course progress remain browser-held.
